title: orchestrator · Assign manager to define a bounded benchmark comparing dynamic memory
summary: Assign manager to define a bounded benchmark comparing dynamic memory against static baselines under fixed token budgets.
body: The previous loop closed due to missing empirical evidence; sources described methods but failed to compare them at equal costs. We must now target a specific benchmark to test if dynamic consolidation truly outperforms simple baselines like append-only Markdown when token budgets are matched. This requires defining a reproducible test case with clear metrics (success rate, hallucination rate) and a strict stopping rule for source inspection.
